sentences.text: For this UCB, penal charges may not be capitalised, so there is no permitted compounding frequency for penal interest or penal charges.
The current directions say there must be no capitalization of the penal charges, meaning no further interest is computed on those charges.
They also say additional or fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
The older 2023 circulars that mentioned normal procedures for compounding of interest are superseded and no longer in force.
